newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil mudslide kills six people.
newsitem.headline: Brazil mudslide kills six people.

text.p: Six people were killed and four injured on Monday in a mudslide which pulled down three houses in Petropolis 41 miles (66 km) north of Rio de Janeiro, a disaster relief spokeswoman said.
She said the houses were washed down a hillside after more than two hours of rain in the early hours of the morning while the occupants were asleep.
The injured were taken to a hospital in Petropolis.
